name: Board Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  Meeting of the
  Westlake Village Community Foundation
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive

  Tuesday, February 22, 2022 12:00 Noon

  Written comments may be sent to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org
  no later than 9:00 a.m. on Tuesday, February 22, 2022. Written comments will be
  summarized during the meeting.

Due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, City Councilmembers and staff are participating in this
 meeting via teleconference pursuant to Government Code Section 54953(e). In the interest of
maintaining appropriate social distancing, a physical location is not being provided for the public
  to attend or comment. Members of the public may observe the meeting telephonically or
 otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service, and may offer comment in real
  time, with the following steps:

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86456625208
  Or One tap mobile :
  US: +16699009128,,86456625208# or +12532158782,,86456625208#
  Or Telephone:
  Dial(for higher quality, dial a number based on your current location):
  US: +1 669 900 9128 or +1 253 215 8782 or +1 346 248 7799 or +1 646 558 8656
  Webinar ID: 864 5662 5208

Teleconference participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification
or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the
City at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and distributed
by the Board Members less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for public inspection at City Hall
(31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business hours.
 CALL TO ORDER:  12:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Foundation Members Croner, Honig, Halpern and McSweeney

PUBLIC COMMENTS:  Members of the public may address the Board on items not on the
  printed on the agenda.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:  October 26, 2021 Meeting

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  1.  Appointment of New Board Member - Beverly Brutzkus
  2.  Financial Update
  3.  Formal Approval of Amended and Restated Bylaws
  4.  Appointment of Foundation Secretary

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Wednesday, February 16, 2022 at 11:30 a.m. on the City website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.
